paper_title: Earth as a transducer for axion dark-matter detection
notes: Search for axion-photon coupling via oscillating geomagnetic signal in SuperMAG data, mass range 2e-18 to 7e-17 eV. Strongest limit g_agamma <= 6.5e-11 GeV^-1 for 3e-17 to 4e-17 eV (note: conclusion text also quotes 3e-18 to 4e-18 eV for the same value, likely a typo). Full exclusion curve is in Fig. 1 but not available as a table; only the strongest limit value is given numerically in the text. The signal amplitude relation B ~ 1nG*(g/1e-10 GeV^-1) at rho_dm=0.3 GeV/cm^3 is given. Emitted a two-point horizontal segment at the strongest limit; actual curve varies with mass. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 31)) | Vision: Traced the lower boundary of the blue exclusion band (approx. the smoothed cyan line). Limit is most sensitive (~5e-11 GeV^-1) around 3-4e-17 eV, reaching the CAST bound. X-axis is log scale from 3e-18 to 6e-17 eV; top axis shows frequency.
